title: Grusch says Cheney was the last at the top of a legacy UFO program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Grusch says Cheney was the last at the top of a legacy UFO program, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Brush said that he was the last guy to be at the pyramid when you know we had some vital legacy UFO program structure.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that David Grusch, a man who has spoken out about secret UFO programmes, told him something about Dick Cheney, the former US vice president. According to Michels, Grusch said Cheney was the last person to sit at the top of a long-running secret government UFO programme, sometime in the 2000s. If true, it would mean such a programme was once overseen from the highest levels of the US government.
